newsitem.title: GERMANY: German president's plane makes emergency landing.
newsitem.headline: German president's plane makes emergency landing.

text.p: A plane bringing German President Roman Herzog back to Berlin after a state visit to France made an emergency landing in Cologne on Saturday after a pane of glass in the cockpit window smashed, the defence ministry said.
The pane was part of the outermost of three layers of glass in the cockpit window, a ministry spokesman said.
He said none of the passengers was in danger at any stage but the pilot had decided to land in Cologne as a precaution.
The president completed his journey on a replacement plane, the spokesman said. The cause of the incident was still being investigated.
